# Wayne Conrad Advisory

> Operational automation advisory for SME and SMB owners (5 to 50 person service businesses). Helping founders remove themselves from the operational centre of their business through decision-rights redesign and AI implementation.

## Founder & Leadership

- Wayne Conrad: 28 years building service businesses, two exits in 2023, remote-first, operating with clients across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Southeast Asia.

## Core Services & Free Resources

- [Operational Dependency Diagnostic](https://wayneconrad.com/diagnostic.html): A free 5-question AI readiness assessment identifying where a business depends on its founder to run.
- [Founder Bottleneck Scorecard](https://wayneconrad.com/founder_bottleneck_scorecard.html): A free interactive self-assessment across five workstreams, client requests, project updates, approvals, billing, and hiring, naming the first concrete move for each bottleneck.
- [Free Templates & Calculators for SME Owners](https://wayneconrad.com/resources.html): Decision Rights Mapping Template, What Manual Coordination Is Costing You (a coordination-cost calculator), and Client Health Scorecard.
- [Advisory Services](https://wayneconrad.com/growth.html): Operational automation for SME service businesses, a three-stage engagement of diagnose, map, and build.

## Key Articles & Insights

- [The AI Trust Gap](https://wayneconrad.com/ai-trust-gap.html): Why 68% of small business owners believe AI will help their business, but only 22% trust it enough to run unsupervised, and what that gap actually means for a service business.
- [The Hidden Friction Tax](https://wayneconrad.com/articles/hidden-friction-tax.html): Why manual coordination quietly eats 15 to 20 percent of payroll in a service business, and how to reclaim it.
- [Why Adding Headcount Won't Fix an Architecture Problem](https://wayneconrad.com/articles/headcount-vs-architecture.html): Why hiring to absorb operational chaos multiplies complexity instead of solving it.
- [How to Delegate Decision Rights](https://wayneconrad.com/articles/delegate-decision-rights.html): How to delegate authority without losing control, by defining explicit decision boundaries.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [FAQ](https://wayneconrad.com/faq.html): Answers on founder dependency, the AI readiness assessment, engagement length, and how the process works.
